phát triển kiến thức chuyên sâu và năng: Develop in-depth knowledge and research capacity to explore the mechanisms of life, apply biotechnology in biomedicine, health and sustainable development.
sẵn sàng cho bước học tiếp theo?: Ready for the next step in learning?
trao đổi về chương trình, nền tảng đã họ: Discuss the program, your academic background and your goals with us to prepare for your next step.
nghiên cứu sự sống. ứng dụng vì sức khỏe: Explore the Science of Life. Apply It to Health.
chương trình thạc sĩ công nghệ sinh học: The Master of Biotechnology at Van Lang follows a research track, developing advanced knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology and cell biology. Building on this foundation, students explore modern technologies in molecular diagnostics, gene therapy, cell therapy and bioinformatics.
với 27 tín chỉ dành cho hai chuyên đề ng: With 27 credits for two research modules and thesis, the program focuses on the ability to identify problems, design research, conduct experiments, analyze data and present scientific results.
người học có cơ hội kết nối nghiên cứu v: Students have the opportunity to connect research with practice at the University, institutes, research centers and businesses; at the same time, develop a sense of research ethics, biosafety and responsibility to the community.
văn bằng tốt nghiệp: thạc sĩ công nghệ s: Degree awarded: Master of Engineering in Biotechnology.
chuyên đề và luận văn 45% khối lượng chư: Topics and thesis 45% of program load 27 credits
nghiên cứu chiếm 45% chương trình: Research accounts for 45% of the program
hai chuyên đề nghiên cứu, mỗi chuyên đề: Two research modules, each 6 credits, and a 15-credit thesis create space for students to develop an in-depth the research track.
kết nối kiến thức sinh học phân tử và tế: Connect molecular and cell biology knowledge with gene therapy, immunology, molecular diagnostics and specialized electives.
học phần tin sinh học ứng dụng giúp ngườ: The Applied Bioinformatics module helps students access genomic data and omics data, practice skills in processing, analyzing and interpreting results.
học viên được tham quan, kiến tập, thực: Subject to the academic plan, students may undertake visits, study activities, practical training and thesis research at the University, institutes, research centers and businesses.
học viên được tạo điều kiện đăng ký đề t: Students may register for University-level research projects. Those who meet the language requirements may be introduced to international research opportunities; students with strong research results receive faculty guidance on publishing research articles and opportunities for doctoral study.
sáu chuẩn đầu ra bao quát kiến thức chuy: Six learning outcomes cover in-depth knowledge, research skills, autonomy and responsibility in scientific activities.
vận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về sinh họ: Apply in-depth knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, cell biology, immunology and microbiology to analyze and explain biological phenomena, pathology and scientific problems in the field of biotechnology.
phân tích nguyên lý và đánh giá khả năng: Analyze the principles and evaluate the applicability of modern biotechnologies in biomedicine and health, including molecular diagnostics, vaccines, biotherapy, bionanotechnology and bioinformatics.
thiết kế, triển khai và đánh giá một ngh: Design, conduct and evaluate a biotechnology research study using sound scientific methodology, from defining the research problem to analyzing and interpreting the results.
phân tích, xử lý và trình bày dữ liệu ng: Analyze, process and present scientific research data using appropriate tools and methods, meeting scientific reporting and publication requirements at the Master's level.
làm việc độc lập hoặc phối hợp trong nhó: Work independently or collaboratively in a research team, organize and manage research activities, and proactively update knowledge in biotechnology.
tuân thủ đạo đức nghiên cứu, trung thực: Comply with research ethics, scientific integrity, biosafety and related legal regulations; demonstrate social responsibility in research and application of biotechnology for sustainable development.

người muốn đi sâu vào nghiên cứu: People who want to go deeper into research
phát triển nền tảng sinh học thành năng: Develop a background in biology into the capacity to ask scientific questions, design experiments, analyze data and conduct independent research.
cập nhật kiến thức và phương pháp phục v: Update knowledge and methods for work in laboratories, research units, biotechnology or biomedical enterprises.
người hướng đến giảng dạy và học tiếp: People who aim to teach and continue learning
củng cố kiến thức chuyên sâu và năng lực: Strengthen in-depth knowledge and research capacity to prepare for academic work or a study journey at the PhD level.

chương trình đào tạo theo định hướng nào: Which Track Does the Program Offer?
chương trình thạc sĩ công nghệ sinh học: The Master of Biotechnology follows a research track, comprising 60 credits over a standard duration of 24 months and 6 semesters. The research component includes two 6-credit research modules and a 15-credit thesis.
tôi cần đáp ứng điều kiện gì để dự tuyển: What conditions do I need to meet to apply?
ứng viên đã tốt nghiệp hoặc đủ điều kiện: Applicants must hold or be eligible to receive, a bachelor's degree or higher in an appropriate field and meet the foreign language entry requirements. Any required bridging courses must be completed before admission assessment. Applications are reviewed according to University regulations and admissions announcements.
tốt nghiệp ngành khác có thể dự tuyển kh: Can I apply if I have graduated from another major?
người tốt nghiệp công nghệ sinh học, kỹ: Graduates in Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Applied Biology, Biology and Biology Education are exempt from bridging courses. Transcripts from listed related fields are reviewed to determine bridging requirements of up to 6 credits. Fields not listed are reviewed individually by the relevant committee.
người học có phải học toàn bộ 9 học phần: Do students have to take all 9 elective modules?
người học tích lũy tối thiểu 12 tín chỉ: Students accumulate a minimum of 12 credits in their chosen major, equivalent to 4 out of 9 modules, each module has 3 credits. Courses are registered according to the research track and class plan of the program.
ngôn ngữ giảng dạy và yêu cầu ngoại ngữ: What is the language of instruction and foreign language requirements?
The program is taught in Vietnamese. Foreign language proficiency equivalent to Level 3 or above is required for admission and Level 4 or above is required before graduation under Vietnam's six-level foreign language proficiency framework. Accepted evidence is assessed according to University regulations and announcements.
lịch học có phù hợp với người đang đi là: Is the study schedule suitable for working people?
lịch học dự kiến bố trí vào buổi tối các: Class schedules are expected to be arranged in the evenings on weekdays and/or Saturdays and Sundays, according to each semester's plan. The official timetable is announced by the University. You can discuss with the Institute to arrange work and study and research plans.
học phí và chính sách hỗ trợ được áp dụn: How are tuition fees and support policies applied?
học phí toàn khóa là 85.000.000 đồng, ch: Total program tuition is VND 85,000,000, divided into three installments: VND 29,750,000, VND 25,500,000 and VND 29,750,000. Separate fees apply on a case-by-case basis. Scholarships and financial support are assessed according to University eligibility criteria, supporting documents and announcements; only the highest eligible benefit within the specified policy groups applies, with no combining of benefits.
